adapter.implementation_boundary: The adapter accepts only the BPM generated static index and does not call, name, or render a vendor search UI. The DOM shell supplies localized labels and rendering.

state.recent_query_storage: locale-scoped browser localStorage; URL query takes precedence when present
state.unknown_url_filters: ignore values not declared by the generated locale index
state.history: hydrate initial and popstate URL state without writing a new history entry

result.link_policy: Only same-origin normalized paths under /help/{active locale}/ may be rendered as result links; invalid URLs render as plain titles.

preserve: Escape collapses only the open advanced panel and preserves query/filter state
focus returns to the advanced toggle after Escape collapse

error.index_load_failure: show the locale-owned unavailable state; keep the rest of the documentation portal usable
error.network_boundary: fetch only the generated same-origin index with credentials: same-origin; no remote or vendor request is allowed

non_goals: add a dependency or vendor-specific browser UI
add AI, telemetry, or network search
replace the existing documented facet or URL contracts
